texts.t: Siena connects directly to thousands of carriers to track packages in real-time. Answer shipping questions, resolve delivery issues, and provide accurate order updates.
I'm sorry for the delay. Your order has been stuck at the carrier's distribution center for 7 days. I'm sending a replacement with expedited shipping right away.
Hi! Can you check what's going on with my order?
Your Agent's direct line to carriers
When customers ask about their order, Siena pulls current tracking data and delivers clear, accurate updates in seconds.
Real-time status with full delivery context
My order has been stuck in customs for a week
I see it cleared customs this morning and is now with Royal Mail. Updated ETA is Monday.
When a package gets stuck, Siena knows before your customer complains. The agent flags delays, notifies your team, and reaches out proactively.
Your package has been sitting in the same facility for 3 days. I've flagged this with our fulfillment team and will update you within 24 hours
Native tracking infrastructure is included in your platform. Handle order inquiries without managing separate tracking subscriptions or maintaining additional integrations.
Does tracking work for international shipments with customs delays?
Yes. Siena Order Tracking covers international shipments across customs checkpoints, regional carriers, and last-mile delivery. Whether packages move through customs or transfer between international
How does Siena handle tracking numbers that work across multiple carriers?

Siena's infrastructure automatically detects which carrier is handling each package based on the tracking number format and shipping details. This eliminates errors from routing tracking queries to th
Does Siena work with returns or order tracking platforms?
Yes. Siena integrates with returns platforms like Loop Returns and order tracking platforms like AfterShip. If you already use these tools, Siena works alongside them.
Can Siena track packages from regional or specialty carriers?

Yes. Native tracking supports over 2000 carriers worldwide, including regional carriers, specialty logistics providers, and local delivery services. Whether you use major carriers like FedEx or region
